fact: TechCabal reports Morocco's startups attracted more than USD 25 million in total funding in the first half of 2026, an aggregate across deals with no financier or recipient named.
Launchbase Africa reports Moroccan superapp Ora Technologies secured a USD 7.5 million Series A led by local VC Azur Innovation Management.
Launchbase Africa reports Ora Technologies raised a USD 1.9 million pre-Series A in March 2025 led by Azur Innovation and Witamax.
Launchbase Africa says Ora's Series A was led by Moroccan VC Azur Innovation Management with three additional Moroccan strategic investors.
The UM6P Morocco Startup Ecosystem Report, as relayed by LesEco.ma, counts $108.44 million raised by Moroccan startups across 48 disclosed deals in 2025, 67.92% of it from foreign funds.

Challenge.ma reported on 8 December 2025 that Proparco and IFC had committed USD 40 million to Emtech II, a Moroccan-law venture fund for tech startups run by EmergingTech Ventures, with final closing imminent.
